title: A Log piece's front matter — content/log/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md
description: The block between the two --- lines at the top of a Log piece. The piece itself is Markdown below it. `npm run check` reads this file for the list of allowed names, so a misspelt one is caught rather than silently dropped.

title.description: The headline. A claim reads better than a topic.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the same date as the filename. It is the date the piece is published under, in the list, the feed and the email.

dek.description: One line under the title: what the piece argues. It is also the search description, the share card and the email preview.

across.description: Comma-separated references to what the piece argues with: press:<id>, lives:<id>, atlas:<principle-id>. Each must exist. Printed as 'Reads across to'.

status.description: draft stays off the site. published prints it, adds it to the feed and the sitemap.
